source.citation: Abendpost (Chicago), 9 August 1905, vol. 17, no. 187: 'Bau-Erlaubnisscheine wurden ausgestellt an...' (building permits issued), including Taprell, Loomis & Co., a four-storey brick building, 1727 to 1737 Indiana Ave.
what_it_does_not_supply: what stood on the lots before it
what_it_supplies: the 1727-1737 factory was permitted in August 1905, so it did not stand on 1 July 1904
